block.guguaddons.source_converter.toolti: Refines _Liquid Source_ into _Source_ to power arcane devices.
Keep the tank _around half full_ for _full yield_. Too little or too much liquid will _greatly reduce output_.
Feeds on _Source_ and _Experience Nuggets_ to turn nearby _Deepslate_ into _Sculk_.
Must sit directly on an _Activated Sculk Catalyst_. Deepslate on the catalyst's layer within a 7x7 area is converted.
Each batch converts a few blocks; new sculk with free space above may grow a _Sculk Sensor_ or _Sculk Shrieker_.
Awakens it only _without sky access_, _deep underground_ (Y < 0), once the whole 7x7 area has _turned to Sculk_.
block.guguaddons.warden_resonance_chambe: Locks a _Warden_ in a soundproof jar and stimulates it at different frequencies for its _Carapace_ or a _Resonance Nucleus_.
Only works in _the Otherside_, with _no light at all_ inside. Needs nearby _Source Jars_ and _stress_.
A _weak_ signal is low frequency and calms the Warden; a _strong_ one is high frequency and makes it _agitated_.
The more agitated, the more it yields - until it _snaps_. Comparators read its mood; _wool_ calms it down.
block.guguaddons.warden_resonance_kineti: Supplies stress to the _Warden Resonance Chamber_.
Goes in the _back middle_ of the bottom layer, _shaft side_ facing out; connect power on that side.
